name: shoulder-shrug-barbell
title: Shoulder Shrug: Barbell
primer: This is an exercise for trapezius strengthening.
steps: Stand on the floor with your abs drawn in and your back straight.
Grasp a barbell with a grip a little wider than shoulder width at arm's length.
Drop your shoulders as much as possible to start.
Raise your shoulders as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top and then return to the starting position in a controlled motion.
tips: Do not arch your back at all during the exercise.
